digestFormats.entries: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 name NUL bytes NUL entries; UTF-16 code-unit name order
digestFormats.json: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON.stringify(value), without whitespace or trailing newline
digestFormats.sourceDigest: entries over every loaded module name and exact source
digestFormats.interfacesDigest: entries over binding and JSON.stringify({type,axioms}); type is canonicalHasher SHA-1; axioms sorted
digestFormats.declarationFuelDigest: json of [binding,searchFuel] pairs sorted by binding; object key order is checker serialization order
digestFormats.generatedNamesDigest: json of sorted generated binding names
digestFormats.assumptionDependenciesDigest: json of [binding,sorted axioms] pairs sorted by binding
digestFormats.typeDigest: canonicalHasher SHA-1 (tools/canonical-hash.mjs), alpha-invariant for bound terms and dimensions
